question: Which of the 12 findings in the review of PR #17 still reproduce on the merged code (commit 4d4cf5a)?

items.evidence: derive-R05.mjs F5: project = repo root: cursor/opencode/fake adapter files leave `git status` clean and removal succeeds; project = repo/pkg subdirectory: after cursorAdapter.prepare(workdir) `git status --porcelain -uall` = "?? pkg/.cursor/mcp.json" and removeTaskWorktree without force: "REFUSED: worktree for task 1 has uncommitted changes". Cause: src/worktree.ts:39 ADAPTER_FILES = [".cursor/mcp.json", ...] is appended to info/exclude (:148-158); a pattern with an inner slash is anchored to the repo root, so it does not match <subdir>/.cursor/mcp.json, while the cursor adapter writes into context.workdir (src/adapters.ts:384-385), which is the project subdirectory inside the worktree (src/worktree.ts:160-162). opencode.json and .agent-bus/ (no inner slash) are matched at any depth.

derive-R05.mjs F8: user's worktree (directory deleted, simulating an unmounted drive, not locked) registered before: true, after creating a task worktree: false. src/worktree.ts:181 runs an unconditional-scope `git worktree prune` whenever ANY registered worktree is prunable, which drops every prunable registration, not only this task's path.
